title: Avoid head-anchored visionOS content

statement.en: Avoid anchoring visionOS content to the wearer’s head.
statement.ja: visionOS contentを利用者のheadにanchorしない。

conditions: Head anchoring can feel confining and reduce the apparent stability of surroundings.
exceptions: Anchor content in a person’s space so they can look around naturally.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Spatial layout experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるSpatial layoutの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Use depth only when it adds value

statement.en: Use visionOS depth only where it clarifies, delights, or separates important content.
statement.ja: clarity、delight、important contentの分離に価値がある場合だけvisionOS depthを使う。

conditions: Prefer depth for large, important interface elements.
Review repeated depth changes because refocusing can be tiring.
exceptions: Avoid depth that reduces legibility or usability on small objects.
